title: SSC CGL 2026 Notification OUT - 12,256 Vacancies, Apply at ssc.gov.in by June 22
author: Ash K.
summary: SSC CGL 2026 notification officially released on May 21 for 12,256 Group B and C vacancies across central government departments. Apply online at ssc.gov.in by June 22. Tier 1 in Aug-Sep 2026. New: sectional timing introduced. Graduation required. Fee ₹100.
body: The Staff Selection Commission has officially released the SSC CGL 2026 notification on May 21, 2026 at ssc.gov.in. This is the biggest SSC recruitment of 2026 - 12,256 vacancies across 40 Group B and C posts in central government ministries and departments.

DetailInformation
Total Vacancies12,256 (Group B + C)
Notification ReleasedMay 21, 2026
Apply StartMay 21, 2026
Last Date to ApplyJune 22, 2026 (11:00 PM)
Fee Payment DeadlineJune 23, 2026 (11:00 PM)
Correction WindowJune 29 – July 1, 2026
EligibilityGraduation in any discipline
Age Limit18-32 years (post-wise)
Application Fee₹100 (Gen/OBC) | Free for SC/ST/PwBD/Women
Tier 1 ExamAugust-September 2026
Tier 2 ExamDecember 2026
New ChangeSectional timing in Tier 1 and Tier 2
InterviewNo interview - Tier 1 + Tier 2 + DV only
Salary RangeLevel 4 (₹25,500) to Level 7 (₹44,900)

What's new in SSC CGL 2026: Sectional timing introduced in both Tier 1 and Tier 2. Each section now has a fixed time limit - you cannot move between sections. Also, Aadhaar-based authentication introduced during OTR (One Time Registration). Candidates using Aadhaar may not need photo ID at the exam centre.

Major posts: Income Tax Inspector (Level 7), CBI Sub-Inspector (Level 7), Assistant Section Officer in MEA/CSS (Level 6), Auditor in CAG/CGDA (Level 5), Statistical Investigator Grade II (Level 7), Tax Assistant in CBDT/CBIC (Level 4). All posts are in central government departments with full benefits.

Tier 1 exam pattern: 100 MCQs, 200 marks, 60 minutes. Four sections with sectional timing - General Intelligence (15 min), General Awareness (15 min), Quantitative Aptitude (15 min), English Comprehension (15 min). Negative marking: 0.50 per wrong answer. Tier 1 is qualifying - only Tier 2 marks count for merit.

How to apply: Visit ssc.gov.in → One Time Registration (if not done) → Login → Click SSC CGL 2026 → Fill application → Upload live photo (webcam/smartphone - pre-existing photos not allowed) → Pay ₹100 fee → Submit before June 22.
Important: Pre-existing photographs are no longer permitted. You must capture a live photograph using webcam or smartphone during application. Applications with uploaded photos will be rejected.
For complete SSC CGL preparation, check our SSC CGL 2026 exam guide with syllabus, previous papers, and strategy. Compare career options in our Bank PO vs SSC CGL vs State PSC comparison.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: 12,256 vacancies across 40 Group B and C posts in central government ministries and departments.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply for SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: June 22, 2026 (11:00 PM). Fee payment deadline is June 23, 2026. Correction window is June 29 to July 1.

faqs.question: What is new in SSC CGL 2026 exam pattern?
faqs.answer: Sectional timing is introduced in both Tier 1 and Tier 2. Each section has a fixed time limit and you cannot switch between sections. Also, live photo capture is mandatory during application.

faqs.question: What is the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam date?
faqs.answer: Tier 1 CBT is scheduled for August-September 2026. Tier 2 is in December 2026. Exact dates will be notified later.

faqs.question: Is there interview in SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: No. There is no interview. Selection is based on Tier 1 (qualifying), Tier 2 (merit), and Document Verification only.

faqs.question: What is the salary for SSC CGL posts?
faqs.answer: Entry-level posts start at Level 4 (₹25,500-81,100) and go up to Level 7 (₹44,900-1,42,400). Top posts like Income Tax Inspector and CBI SI are at Level 7.

callout.heading: Live Photo Required - No Uploaded Photos
callout.content: SSC CGL 2026 requires live photograph capture using webcam or smartphone during application. Pre-existing photographs will be rejected. Ensure good lighting and plain background. Aadhaar-based authentication is available for faster verification.
